summary: Iteration 7 SECURITY-ONLY backend testing complete. All 28 new security tests (test_security_auth.py) PASS + full regression on iterations 4/5/6 (90 tests) PASS. Verified: password strength floor (8+ chars, letter+digit), role escalation blocked for public registration, admin-token can create elevated roles, non-admin bearer cannot, /api/seed platform_admin-gated (401 anon / 403 student / 200 admin), brute-force lockout after 8 fails triggers 429 including with subsequent correct password, lockout per-{ip:email} identifier isolates victims, counter clears via delete, no user-enumeration (identical 'Invalid credentials' detail on wrong email vs wrong password), all seeded creds (student/faculty/admin) still log in, /api/auth/me returns correct role, bcrypt hashes still valid, ANCR link-registry + resolve-link intact.

minor.issue: Password-strength errors are raised as HTTPException(422) with a bare string detail. FastAPI's own 422 shape is a list of {loc,msg,type} dicts, so frontend code handling validation errors must special-case this endpoint. Consider using a Pydantic validator on UserCreate.password so the shape is uniform, or return 400.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1900 LOC — split into routers/ modules (auth, projects, production, faculty, notifications) before it grows further; refactor is orthogonal to security.

_check_and_record_login_attempt() has a small race: two concurrent bad logins can both pass the count<8 check and both increment. Mitigated by MongoDB $inc atomicity but the 429-raise happens BEFORE the increment. Acceptable for auth throttling.

_login_key relies on the first hop of x-forwarded-for; behind a shared load balancer without XFF sanitization, all callers could share a key. Document trust boundary or use request.client.host by default.
Password floor uses HTTPException(422) with a plain string — inconsistent with FastAPI's own 422 detail shape (list of ErrorModel). Suggest promoting to a Pydantic field_validator or use 400.
PUBLIC_SELF_REGISTER_ROLES = {student, collaborator} — worth logging every elevated-role registration for audit.
seed_data_creation: None. Test creates TEST_ prefixed users in @cynaiah-test.example.com domain; note that .test TLD is rejected by pydantic EmailStr so used .example.com.
